prerequisites: The student must be capable of solving the set of linear and quadratic equations.
Calculus (differentiation and integration) in one variable.

learning_outcomes.text: Proper formulation of motion definition, i.e. the students have to be able to determine how to set the position of a point, rigid body, or a system of rigid bodies, in any instant of time.
On the basis of a position task solution other kinematic quantities (velocities and accelerations) are to be determined.
Determination of the kinematic quantities is necessary for further dynamic solving.
Students will be able to analyse the movement from the point of view of kinematics and to perform the solution of motion variables determination.
They will be able to analyse mechanisms, and on the basis of a set position determine the velocity and acceleration in arbitrary moment of time.
As the matrix arithmetic is used during the analysis, the student will be able to solve kinematic problems using the computers.

syllabus_topics: Kinematics of a particle, harmonic motion.
Absolute general plane motion, analytical analysis.
Absolute general plane motion, graphical analysis.
Three-dimensional motion of a rigid body. Rotation about a fixed point.
General three-dimensional motion of a rigid body.Screw motion.
Relative motion analysis. Coexistent rotary motion, gears.
Kinematics of planar mechanisms. Graphical analysis.
Kinematics of planar mechanisms. Analytical analysis.
Linkages with a cam. Alternate linkages. Coriolis's method.
Rectilinear and curvilinear motion of a point
Rectilinear and curvilinear motion of a point.
assessment_rules: The course-unit credit is granted under the condition of active participation in seminars and passing the seminar tests of basic knowledge (at least 10 ECTS points out of 20 must be gained). The written part of the examination plays a decisive role, where a maximum of 80 ECTS points can be reached. The final evaluation is the sum of points gained in seminars and at the examination. To pass the course, at least 50 points must be reached.
